title: Maintaining Drainage Flow: Correct Pipe Slope
description: Maintaining proper horizontal drainage slope is essential for waste conveyance. If a drain line lacks sufficient fall, solids settle and cause recurring blockages. Conversely, excessive pitch can cause liquids to rush ahead, leaving solid waste behind. Over time, inadequate pipe support can cause sagging or bellies where stagnant water collects. Inspecting pipe hangers, checking pitch with a torpedo level, and securing lines prevents long-term sediment accumulation and DWV failure.
caption:
Maintaining Drainage Flow: Correct Pipe Slope

Maintaining proper horizontal drainage slope is essential for waste conveyance. If a drain line lacks sufficient fall, solids settle and cause recurring blockages. Conversely, excessive pitch can cause liquids to rush ahead, leaving solid waste behind. Over time, inadequate pipe support can cause sagging or bellies where stagnant water collects. Inspecting pipe hangers, checking pitch with a torpedo level, and securing lines prevents long-term sediment accumulation and DWV failure.
